item.title: Concern grows over future for Quinte West’s street nurse and community support worker
item.description: Leaders from the partners in the community and Trenton Downtown Business Improvement Area (DBIA) are raising concerns about the future of an integral service provided to the city’s most vulnerable. Trenton’s community street nurse as well as its community support worker roles are at risk of being ended in April due to decreases in funding. […]

item.title: Loyalist College reports highest winter enrolment numbers on record
item.description: A record number of students are attending Loyalist College this winter semester with 3,740 learners welcomed in January 2023. The largest-ever cohort of winter semester students ever surpasses the previous winter enrolment record set by the College in 2020 by four percent. The surge in Loyalist’s enrolment continues the positive trend established at the outset of the academic year when the College announced its highest-ever fall semester enrolment, the college said in a press […]

item.description: Letter to Editor: I am writing in response to the recent article in The Community Press about wetlands in the Brighton area.
